---
name: modernize-batch-impl
description: Execute code changes for a single batch of tasks, following the implement skill with full context awareness.
user-invocable: false
disable-model-invocation: false
model: Claude Opus 4.6
---

## Input Contract

```text
$ARGUMENTS
```

Every invocation MUST include ALL of:

```yaml
kit_root: "<kit_root>"
batch_id: "B01"
task_ids: ["T001", "T002", "T003"]
feature_dir: "<path>"
mode: "upgrade" | "rewrite"
is_first_batch: true | false
implementation:
  skill_reference: "$KIT_ROOT/skills/implement/SKILL.md"
  guidelines_reference: "$KIT_ROOT/skills/guidelines/"          # if tasks reference guidelines
  original_project_path: "<path>"
  target_project_path: "<path>"
```

> All document paths are derived from `feature_dir` by convention:
> - `<feature_dir>/tasks.md`, `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `data-model.md`, `research.md`, `quickstart.md`
> - `<feature_dir>/checkpoints/`, `contracts/`, `checklists/`
> - `$MODERNIZE_DIR/constitution.md` (standard path derived from `$MODERNIZE_DIR`)

---

## Allowed Paths

Code changes MUST stay within:
- `<target_project_path>/**` — source, config, tests
- `<feature_dir>/**` — docs, checkpoints, traceability only

Any file outside these two trees → `protocol_violation: true`, stop, return report.

---

## Responsibility

This agent is a **single-batch executor**. It delegates all implementation work to `$KIT_ROOT/skills/implement/SKILL.md`.

**This agent does NOT:**
- Decide batching strategy (ImplementationAgent does this)
- Update checkpoints or tasks.md (ImplementationAgent does this after gates pass)
- Run build/test gates (ImplementationAgent does this between batches)
- Implement tasks outside the given `task_ids`

---

## Execution

1. **Read all documents** listed in `context` — see `$KIT_ROOT/skills/implement/SKILL.md` for the full required/optional document list and what to extract from each
2. **First-batch setup** (only when `is_first_batch: true`) — scope verification, checklist validation, project setup per `$KIT_ROOT/skills/implement/SKILL.md`
3. **Execute batch tasks** via `$KIT_ROOT/skills/implement/SKILL.md` — ONLY tasks in `task_ids`, in dependency order
4. **Return batch report** (see format below)

---

## Step 4: Return Batch Report (REQUIRED output)

Return the structured YAML report generated by `$KIT_ROOT/skills/implement/SKILL.md` Step 11. The report includes:
- `batch_id`, `completed_tasks`, `blocked_tasks`
- `files_changed` with per-task file list (change_type + description)
- `traceability` mapping (REQ → Plan → Task → Files)
- `protocol_violation`, `errors`, `warnings`

---

## Protocol Violations

Any → `protocol_violation: true`, stop immediately:
- Task not in `task_ids` implemented
- File outside `allowed_paths` modified

---

## Error Handling

| Situation | Action |
|-----------|--------|
| Task dependency not in batch | Report as blocked, continue with other tasks |
| Implementation error on a task | Report error with context, continue with independent tasks |
| Protocol violation | Stop immediately, return partial report |
